title: Verity: Something Is Coming
blurb: 'Something is coming.' — Verity's warning line, delivered in that unnervingly calm register that made the series a phenomenon. It's the perfect dread sound: no scream, no music sting, just a quiet statement of fact about something you cannot see yet. Use it for ominous foreshadowing, or to ruin a friend's evening.
origin: A warning line from the Verity Minecraft horror series.
